mapper.insert: INSERT INTO zhw_branch (story_id, parent_id, parent_type, chapter_num, chapter_title, content, user_id, like_count, view_count, comment_count, child_count, del_flag, create_by, create_time) VALUES (#{storyId}, #{parentId}, #{parentType}, #{chapterNum}, #{chapterTitle}, #{content}, #{userId}, 0, 0, 0, 0, '0', #{createBy}, NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE zhw_branch SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
UPDATE zhw_branch SET like_count = like_count + #{delta} WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
UPDATE zhw_branch SET comment_count = comment_count + #{delta} WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
UPDATE zhw_branch SET child_count = child_count + #{delta} WHERE branch_id = #{branchId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM zhw_branch WHERE story_id = #{storyId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(like_count), 0) FROM zhw_branch WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND del_flag = '0'

SELECT b.branch_id, b.story_id, b.parent_id, b.parent_type, b.chapter_num, b.chapter_title, b.content, b.user_id, b.like_count, b.view_count, b.comment_count, b.child_count, b.del_flag, b.create_by, b.create_time, u.nick_name AS author_nick_name FROM zhw_branch b LEFT JOIN zhw_user u ON u.user_id = b.user_id WHERE b.story_id = #{storyId} AND b.del_flag = '0' ORDER BY b.parent_id ASC, b.create_time ASC
